description: Epicenter’s Folders window: it lists every folder in the Epicenter folder and keeps each in sync by composing @epicenter/folder/platform in its page (ADR-0817, ADR-0819). It reaches the Epicenter folder and each folder in it through the folder plugin (`epicenter-folder:epicenter` lists and makes them; `epicenter-folder:default` opens each as a root and reads and writes it), reads who is signed in from the app's data (`account.json`), and sends its folder requests through the shell's sign-in (`account_fetch`), which holds the token; it may start a sign-in, and only Settings signs out. Its page is served on the local epicenter-app scheme.
